decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed first floor rear extension due to its size, scale, and position, built up to the adjoining boundary, would result in the loss of sunlight and daylight to the first floor rear window at No. 70 Kingsley Road.  It is therefore considered that the proposal is contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 3 - The proposed first floor rear extension due to its size and scale, built in between the side wall of original two storey rear addition and the north boundary of the site would be harmful to the appearance of the building and the surrounding area.  It is therefore considered that the proposal is contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 4 - The proposed first floor rear extension would result in the removal of a first floor window to the lounge of the first floor flat at 68 Kingsley Road.  This would result in the loss of outlook and daylight to this room, which would result in substandard accommodation. It is therefore considered that the proposal is contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 5 - The proposed detached storage building due to its size, site coverage, and theprovision of a storage unit separate from the existing units on this site would result in the over-development of the site, which would be harmful to the appearance of the area. It is therefore considered that the proposal is contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a first floor rear extension, detached single storey storage building to rear, and external alterations.
